summary: RC6 evidence is present, the worktree is clean, explicit ch00 provenance and specimen-level sensitivity artifacts are retained, but RC6 report metadata still points to RC5 report artifacts. Release acceptance is conditional pending correction and superseding audit evidence.

evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned cfd0f3ff0927fae2ed5e34849048c02ca94c6a80 in C:\tmp\saturn-v571-final-audit.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md records the production pipeline and profile Git-blob hashes and states that RC6 evidence was content-identical across the later audit-only review commit.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/provenance/specimens/kj_sv_40xx0.75-1/settings/source_image_manifest.json and the WT counterpart are retained resolved manifests.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:49-52 reports 88 KJ and 67 WT source images resolved to channel 0 with no unresolved or nonzero channels.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/02_quality_control/data/specimen_sensitivity_artifact.json declares analysis_unit biological_specimen and inference_performed false.
The artifact contains two included specimens, one KJ and one WT, and explicitly states that sensitivity rows are descriptive with no group inference.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:16-19 points biological report artifacts and the numeric contract to audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate.
audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report/report_metadata.json:34-36 points quality-control report artifacts to audits/evidence/v571_rc5_candidate.
The RC6 report directory contains corresponding RC6 report artifacts, so metadata does not bind the declared RC6 report to its co-located artifacts.

findings.title: RC6 report metadata references RC5 artifacts
findings.impact: A release consumer following report_metadata.json can retrieve stale RC5 outputs, preventing reliable recovery and invalidating the claim that the RC6 report and manifest are internally consistent.
evidence: The referenced RC6 report artifacts exist under audits/evidence/v571_rc6_candidate/report.
findings.recommendation: Create a superseding audit run whose report_metadata.json points exclusively to RC6 artifacts, regenerate or verify the consistency contract, and rerun the release acceptance gate.

limitations: No full image-processing stack was run.
This review used retained manifests, reports, validation receipts, Git metadata, and focused read-only checks only.
Remote, upstream, tags, and ignored-large-artifact policy were not independently verified because the acceptance request prioritized the specified RC6 evidence and prohibited edits.
recommended_follow_up: Correct the stale RC5 paths in the RC6 report metadata.
Regenerate the affected report metadata or produce a superseding append-only audit run.
Re-run internal report/manifest consistency validation and obtain independent release approval.
